contract.terms_text: RATES INCLUDE: The Nett Rates are per Room basis and include – Full Board – Ayurveda Treatments as per booked Package – Daily Yoga – All Taxes & Service Charges. Minimum Stay: 4 Nights. PANCHAKARMA AYURVEDA PACKAGES (no separate price printed — the room rates above apply): I – "Ayubowan" Slimming Programme – Minimum stay 14 days; II – "Ayubowan" Stress Relief Programme – Minimum stay 14 days; III – "Ayubowan" Rejuvenation Programme – Minimum stay 7 days; IV – Immunity Enhancement Programme – Minimum stay 14 days. AIRPORT TRANSFERS in Highway USD 202 per Car – Arrival & Departure both (Maximum 2 pax). | OFFERS: - 5% Early Bird discount (EBD) for bookings made 75 days before - 10% Early Bird discount (EBD) for bookings made 90 days before. Long Stay offers 1st August 2027 - 31st October 2027: - 5% discount for stays between 14 - 27 days - 10% discount for stays for 28 days and above. Note: Offers/Special offers are non-combinable, except for the Early Bird Discount (EBD). In the event that two or more offers apply, only the offer with the highest value shall apply. SPECIAL OFFERS FOR ALL THE PACKAGES ABOVE: 7 for 6, 14 for 11, 21 for 17 – for all arrivals in May, June & July 2027. (No room-allotment / release-period box is printed on the summer sheet.) | TERMS AND CONDITIONS: "Aitken Spence Hotels" means the particular hotel to which this rate sheet is applicable; "DMC" means any individual, company, organization or entity incl. tour operators, travel agents, corporate clients, event organizers and other intermediaries. * The above rates will only be applicable for B2B operations and will not be entitled for B2C operations. * All rates can only be sold on package basis and not hotel only (if published in any form, not on a sell-alone basis, but sold as a package and with the prior written consent of Aitken Spence Hotel Managements (Private) Limited). * The enclosed rates should not be published on the internet by you or any other third party. * The enclosed rates cannot be extended to any other market. * The resort is 100% Ayurvedic as such consumption of Liquor and Smoking are not allowed within the premises. CHECK IN / CHECK OUT: Check out 1100 hrs / Check In 1200 hrs. CONDITIONS: 1. Above rates are applicable only to the (company name) [placeholder left unfilled on the sheet]. 2. Rates quoted are per room per night inclusive of Government taxes and are nett and non-commissionable. 3. Maximum occupancy per room 02 adults or 02 adults and 01 child under the age of 12 years without extra bed. Or 2 adults and 2 children under the age of 12 years or 3 adults (with an extra bed). 4. DMC will forward to the Hotel the bookings on a "Sell & Report" basis. 5. DMC shall provide the guest with the voucher, which the Hotel undertakes to honour. 8. All reservations should be directed to res.amg@heritancehotels.com on a sell and report basis. 9. The attached terms & conditions form an integral part of this contract. 10. Counterparts / electronic signature. 14. Validity: for the period set out on the main contract, extendable on mutually agreed terms in writing. 15. Complaints: to be recorded in writing at the property prior to departure; no new complaints after check-out; deductions only as agreed in writing; guest to give a letter of discharge on payment of any compensation. 16. Termination: 03 months' prior written notice by registered post/courier; amounts receivable become immediately due; intellectual property to be returned. 17. Advertising participation: approved in writing; fee agreed and invoiced separately. 18. Laws of Sri Lanka; disputes by conciliation within 30 days, then Sri Lankan courts. 19. Force majeure (beyond 90 days the parties may mutually terminate). 20. No partnership; supersedes previous agreements. 21. Valid from the date last signed. Deemed accepted on the arrival of the first guest. Signed for Aitken Spence Hotel Managements (Pvt) Ltd, Managing Agents for Heritance Ayurveda, by Suhith Jayasinghe (General Manager – Sales and Marketing), 2/24/2026; the Avenir Holidays signature and date are blank.
contract.notes: Transcribed from "Avenir Holidays - Summer 2027.pdf" (8 pages), saved to the winter RTS folder on 2 Oct 2026. Hotel Contract – Avenir Holidays between Aitken Spence Hotel Managements (Private) Limited (Managing Agents for Heritance Ayurveda) and Avenir Holidays; signed by the hotel 2/24/2026 (contract_date), Avenir signature blank. Nett USD per room per night, SGL and DBL only, Full Board + Ayurveda treatments as per booked package + daily yoga + all taxes & service charges. MINIMUM STAY 4 NIGHTS on the whole sheet: min_stay 4 is set on the plan and as a restriction, but the rate lookup does NOT enforce it — staff must check the length of stay. The four Panchakarma programmes (minimum 14 / 14 / 7 / 14 days) carry no separate price, so they are described in terms_text and no separate plan was made. "Suite" entered as the existing room type "SUITE"; the other four names match the hotel's existing room types exactly. No gala dinner, triple, child price, guide policy or market list is printed (the rates "cannot be extended to any other market" and are for B2B package sales only). Conditions 6/11 (prepayment) and 7 (invoices within 14 days of invoicing after the services) contradict each other — both entered. Three printed periods; 01 May – 31 Jul and 01 Sep – 31 Oct carry the same figures but are printed as separate columns (kept as two seasons); August is priced on its own → kind peak. Pages 3–8 are the same terms and conditions as the winter sheet, printed in two halves (Excel print area) — read across both halves. No release periods are printed for summer. Offers: 5% EBD (75 days) and 10% EBD (90 days); long-stay 5% (14 – 27 days) / 10% (28 days+) only for 01 Aug – 31 Oct 2027; 7 for 6, 14 for 11, 21 for 17 for all arrivals in May, June & July 2027.
